reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png mascot reference; checked wavy hair, bushy brows, moustache versus chin hair, one mouth, eyewear, uniform, pose, crop, lighting, collar, complete card/note/backplate and visible transparency.

entries.positive_observation: Thick wavy brown hair swept back with a side part and bushy brown eyebrows remain prominent. The broad brown moustache is limited to the upper lip; the chin and jaw remain smooth without a beard, and there is one stern closed mouth beneath it. No headgear or glasses were added. The frontal head and uniformed shoulders, direct gaze, chest-up crop and fairly even frontal light with mild facial shadows are preserved. One dark olive/field-gray uniform, two pale collar tabs, light shirt opening and one dark central tie remain. The collar sits directly around a short broad yellow neck beneath the rounded chin without a stalk, pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note with faint upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior with no visible holes, missing backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 based on actual white/cyan/alpha viewing rather than numbers alone; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact collar-insignia shapes cannot be transcribed from the 65x67 source; only visible pale shapes, count and placement were compared, without adding detailed emblems or decorations. Existing note marks remain indistinct rather than readable text.
